One of the young nobles was called up now. I thought I would question him a little myself. I said:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0026", "tag": "p", "text": "“Can your lordship read?”", "sha256": "f829cbe4157c546fc0ea51d5d928fe7c4e31fc7fcddcaa3fb11ccaacac2392be", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[26]", "source_html": "

“Can your lordship read?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0027", "tag": "p", "text": "His face flushed indignantly, and he fired this at me:", "sha256": "df0bd6f074d78aa0bcc2c05f1551c002ca9e72adc37fedbd91f5543fd9789daa", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[27]", "source_html": "

His face flushed indignantly, and he fired this at me:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0028", "tag": "p", "text": "“Takest me for a clerk? I trow I am not of a blood that—”", "sha256": "ce2c510ea881358e753b38778960462a0d1b84e61adcceccc9d0da41414baf4e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[28]", "source_html": "

“Takest me for a clerk? I trow I am not of a blood that—”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0029", "tag": "p", "text": "“Answer the question!”", "sha256": "30ae7c0489d7c9d56e99d237317bf891b34407b72b469c5b1dc623e92c1ddcc5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[29]", "source_html": "

“Answer the question!”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0030", "tag": "p", "text": "He crowded his wrath down and made out to answer “No.”", "sha256": "c0e4ded434ad38203ea88a19d9502b9038c0909cf1e827c26be2a39f206e5b93", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[30]", "source_html": "

He crowded his wrath down and made out to answer “No.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0031", "tag": "p", "text": "“Can you write?”", "sha256": "2a74860fa223aea9c8e90dd1412924d83db84192d4156dc3fb44f58b85d55bec", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[31]", "source_html": "

“Can you write?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0032", "tag": "p", "text": "He wanted to resent this, too, but I said:", "sha256": "79ee3b3b14493ef713620b0ef0740fd76e08b4814b0fbc68f2af13997ed4ed96", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[32]", "source_html": "

He wanted to resent this, too, but I said:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0033", "tag": "p", "text": "“You will confine yourself to the questions, and make no comments. “You will confine yourself to the questions, and make no comments. You are not here to air your blood or your graces, and nothing of the sort will be permitted. Can you write?”

“No.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0035", "tag": "p", "text": "“Do you know the multiplication table?”", "sha256": "40fa0567b62c9193df6dd0469d81737558e37f61b152ae891e3ee2a0747d28a9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[35]", "source_html": "

“Do you know the multiplication table?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0036", "tag": "p", "text": "“I wit not what ye refer to.”", "sha256": "f8d028f3b16e807f7a9b9a49dac2124e30871e7eb38786fd1b59dcb0fbdda285", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[36]", "source_html": "

“I wit not what ye refer to.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru77-u029-r0037", "tag": "p", "text": "“How much is 9 times 6?”", "sha256": "f0e7619f9cc7276e02e44b715e4c6a6c6ed414a85dba73a1044dc286c4eb3a93", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[33]/p[37]", "source_html": "

“How much is 9 times 6?”
